posts.mainText: White House unveils National AI Policy Framework, prioritizing child safety, data centers, and regulatory sandboxes. Signals push for coordinated federal AI oversight.
posts.replyText: Federal policy fosters coordination across agencies and states, builds legitimacy via prioritized risks, and ensures neutrality through sandboxes balancing innovation and safety.

posts.mainText: California Gov. Newsom signs executive order requiring AI disclosures for state contracts, challenging federal hands-off approach. Spotlights state-federal coordination needs.
posts.replyText: State initiatives test federal legitimacy, urging neutral coordination frameworks to align policies, prevent fragmentation, and uphold consistent AI governance standards nationwide.

posts.mainText: New preprint empirically delineates formal AI governance responsibilities across sectors and regions. Exposes variances in institutional accountability.
posts.replyText: Evidence-based mapping clarifies roles for better coordination, enhances legitimacy through transparent structures, and promotes neutral benchmarks for global AI oversight.

posts.mainText: FINOS releases AI Governance Framework MCP Server to operationalize policies in AI agents, ensuring compliance with regulations.
posts.replyText: Practical tools enable enterprise coordination, legitimacy via auditable compliance, and neutrality in AI decision processes, scaling responsible deployment.

posts.mainText: SAG-AFTRA endorses Trump's AI Policy Framework for protecting performers from AI misuse. Highlights industry role in shaping governance.
posts.replyText: Stakeholder buy-in strengthens policy legitimacy, coordinates protections across creative sectors, and maintains neutrality by addressing sector-specific AI risks equitably.
